title: Match review
switchAccount: Reading local data. Sign in to this player and server to fetch details.
unsupported: Coach analysis is unavailable for this mode. Facts and notes remain available.
newData: New data or rules are available. Regenerate to create a new revision.
invalidLink: This link needs a valid target player.
noReport: No report yet. Generate from local input; missing data will be stated.
gapsHelp: Gaps indicate missing data. Events cover ±60 seconds around the selected time.
chartFailed: Chart unavailable. Use the numeric table below.
goalHelp: At least 5 comparable matches are needed for a baseline and 5 more for evaluation. Otherwise, the goal is saved as a draft.
noGoals: No goals yet. Adopt a goal from a match review.
comparability: Grouped by queue, reliable position, patch and rule version. Groups are not a continuous improvement trend. Meeting a target does not establish significance or causation.
achieved: Current window meets the target. Confirm completion yourself.
notAchieved: Current window has not met the target
goalConfirmHelp: Confirm this change. Resuming starts a new window now; changing the threshold preserves the previous goal and creates a new version.
unsavedHelp: Save or discard notes before closing. Failed saves preserve your draft.
workspaceChanged: The workspace was restored or changed. Previous drafts are available to copy; reload records before editing.
action_development: Check CS and gold at 10 minutes next match and record a repeatable farming goal.
action_deaths: Review each death and nearby objective events; write one action for your next match.
action_objectives: Inspect recorded events within 60 seconds of an objective and set a reminder for the next match.
finding_build: {{count}} recorded personal item or skill events
action_build: Inspect purchases, sales, undos and skill order; record one item to check next match.
reason_zero_denominator: Zero denominator; ratio not applicable (raw K/D/A is retained)
reason_missing_frame_or_opponent: No suitable frame or reliable opponent
reason_item_semantics_unavailable: Patch item semantics unavailable; showing events and IDs only
reason_unlinked_item_undo: An undo could not be linked to its original operation
reason_opponent_unreliable: Position mapping does not uniquely identify an opponent
reason_timeline_gaps: Timeline has gaps or has not been fetched
reason_observation_window_60s_not_causat: Observes recorded events within ±60 seconds; no causal claim
finding_zero_deaths: Zero deaths this match (KDA ratio is not applicable)
reason_event_gaps: Some frames have no event collection; event observations may be incomplete
reason_rule_development_missing: Development observation needs gold frames and a reliable opponent
